oracle_requests_raw.name: oracle_requests_raw
oracle_requests_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  "block_height" AS block_height,
  "block_timestamp" AS block_timestamp,
  "block_timestamp_truncated" AS block_timestamp_truncated,
  "oracle_request_id" AS oracle_request_id,
  "request" AS request,
  "decoded_result" AS decoded_result,
  "oracle_script" AS oracle_script,
  "result" AS result
FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BAND.ORACLE_REQUESTS
oracle_requests_raw.description: Row-level subset of oracle requests with raw JSON columns and basic identifiers. Useful as the canonical starting table for filtering by oracle_script, decoded results, and request parameters.

facebook_completed_orders_cohort.name: facebook_completed_orders_cohort
facebook_completed_orders_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  o."order_id"                        AS order_id,
  o."user_id"                         AS user_id,
  o."status"                          AS status,
  o."created_at"                      AS created_at,
  o."shipped_at"                      AS shipped_at,
  o."delivered_at"                    AS delivered_at,
  o."returned_at"                     AS returned_at,
  o."num_of_item"                     AS num_of_item,
  u."traffic_source"                  AS traffic_source
FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDERS AS o
LEFT JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.USERS AS u
  ON o."user_id" = u."id"
WHERE o."status" = 'completed'
facebook_completed_orders_cohort.description: Subset of orders that are completed and joined to their user traffic source and user id. Keeps one row per order and relevant order-level timestamps and user traffic_source for downstream joins and filters.

monthly_item_profit.name: monthly_item_profit
monthly_item_profit.body_sql:
SELECT
  TO_VARCHAR(TO_DATE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(oi_delivered.delivered_at)), 'YYYY-MM') AS delivery_month,
  SUM(oi_delivered.sale_price - COALESCE(inv_cost.inventory_cost, prod_cost.product_cost)) AS profit_current_month,
  COUNT(1) AS items_delivered
FROM (
  -- base delivered order items: use ORDER_ITEMS table, keep key columns and delivered_at and sale_price
  SELECT
    "id" AS order_item_id,
    "order_id" AS order_id,
    "user_id" AS user_id,
    "product_id" AS product_id,
    "inventory_item_id" AS inventory_item_id,
    "delivered_at" AS delivered_at,
    "sale_price" AS sale_price
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE "delivered_at" IS NOT NULL
) oi_delivered
LEFT JOIN (
  -- inventory cost preferred: pull cost from INVENTORY_ITEMS keyed by inventory_item_id
  SELECT
    "id" AS inventory_item_id,
    "cost" AS inventory_cost
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.INVENTORY_ITEMS
) inv_cost
  ON oi_delivered.inventory_item_id = inv_cost.inventory_item_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- product cost fallback: pull product cost by product_id
  SELECT
    "id" AS product_id,
    "cost" AS product_cost
  FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS
) prod_cost
  ON oi_delivered.product_id = prod_cost.product_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
monthly_item_profit.description: Aggregates profit per calendar month (YYYY-MM) of delivery for each delivered order item. Uses sale_price minus chosen cost (inventory cost preferred, fallback to product cost). Exposes delivery_month and summed profit for that month and the raw item count to support further analytics.
